subject: reasoning
question: In a certain language, ADVICE is written as VDAECI and BELONG is written as LEBGNO. How will BETTER be written in the same language?
solution:
**Logic:** 'First, third fourth and sixth letters are diagonally rearranged'

 ADVICE is written as VDAECI →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ec85907bb4abb505251ce72805d2545ce346ec20fee9fac6ccdf8a51b9fbf46.png] 

BELONG is written as LEBGNO →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7a5b985c28b2a656cf700d4107477f52c0a0c11d6be4192d644ee462051ce58.png] 

Similarly, BETTER will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d96b5a62789b6b5285409f6b5fb09dbbac2423467e6a8e47300ca0395395fdfe.png] 

Here, BETTER is written as **'TEBRET'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
